summary: WorldEntity duplicate-diagnostic retention accepts any non-negative safe-integer capacity through 9007199254740991, leaving an operationally unbounded diagnostic-retention budget. Recommend a bounded follow-up after active PR #293 lands rather than widening the in-flight primary.
evidence: At PR #293 exact head c301d8403d3c1b93ee3b2988f80e9d1e689eb33d, createRegistry validates duplicateDiagnosticCapacity only as a non-negative IEEE-754 safe integer and trims the duplicate diagnostics array only when its count exceeds that caller-provided capacity.

A capacity of 9007199254740991 is therefore accepted; repeated valid duplicate registrations can remain retained below that astronomical threshold, making the diagnostic queue operationally unbounded despite being numerically finite.
tests/world_entity_registry_shape.luau exercises malformed and numeric-safety capacity boundaries but does not establish a project-owned practical maximum or a retention-at-maximum regression.
Docs/QUALITY_STANDARD.md requires explicit queue-length and cache-size budgets for core foundations; this finding is distinct from #293's malformed-input and safe-integer guards.
Source-only/offline finding; no Roblox Studio, runtime physics, or real two-client evidence is claimed.
